correctness.qualification: Untimed guards before measurement; each timed result is also consumed and checked outside timing

protocol.order: Forward/reverse workload order alternates by round; paired libraries share one process and identical inputs
protocol.first: First timed call after untimed correctness checks; not process-cold
protocol.timing: Only operation() is timed; result consumption, assertions, disposal and memory observation are outside timing
protocol.allocation: Observed per-operation heapUsed/ArrayBuffer deltas include GC noise; not total allocation counters
